query:
SELECT
                mui.macro_user_id,
                mui.first_name,
                mui.last_name,
                EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM team_agents a
                    JOIN "User" u ON u.id = a.user_id
                    WHERE u.macro_user_id = mui.macro_user_id
                ) AS "is_agent!"
            FROM macro_user_info mui
            WHERE mui.macro_user_id = $1
